entry_state: Lease termination and remeasurement have separate effects. Pension changes require event-date remeasurement, distinct profit/OCI effects and a reset interest basis; multi-employer information limits do not erase funding obligations. Opening WIP retains earlier cost and effort, and abnormal loss is separately expensed. The next pension-surplus section has introduced refund and contribution-reduction routes whose calculation continues on page 146.
exit_state: Pension availability depends on enforceable refund and funding terms, and restoration cash classification depends on the paid activity with competing interpretations retained. Group impairment tests units before wider groups using adjusted balances. The partial-goodwill discussion distinguishes notional test amounts from recognized goodwill and losses; its larger-unit allocation has been read through page 148 and remains open pending the next transition.
findings: The contribution-reduction calculation floors the combined amount and keeps mutually exclusive routes from double-counting the same surplus.
Restoration presents operating classification as a conditional interpretation supported by a nonbinding staff paper, compares investing treatment and preserves identical total cash.
The group impairment case uses post-loss unit balances and does not mistake a unit recoverable amount for each asset's floor.
Partial goodwill uses notional gross-up only for the impairment test and keeps NCI goodwill losses unrecognized. No new confirmed defect.
